gates.must_not_pass: bad strategy — overall verdict warn or fail counts as CAUGHT, pass is a FALSE NEGATIVE (CI fails)
gates.must_pass: good strategy — overall verdict must be pass, anything else is a FALSE POSITIVE (CI fails)
gates.documented_gap: known v1 blind spot — engine is EXPECTED to pass a bad strategy here; tracked, not gated

cases.label: bad
cases.catches_via: sample_size (n=14 below the 30-trade floor, despite 79% win rate)
cases.rationale: Lucky 14-trade streak. High win rate + high Sharpe, only the sample floor catches it.

cases.label: bad
cases.rationale: Trust anchor: textbook curve-fit. DSR alone only warns (SR=0.18) — the ratio check does the work.

cases.label: bad
cases.rationale: Pure noise, zero edge. Note: two-sided sample_size PASSES here (42% win rate is 'significantly' off 50%) — DSR is the backstop. Proves no single check can be trusted alone.

cases.label: bad
cases.catches_via: deflated_sharpe after 200-trial deflation (same CSV passes with --trials 1)
cases.rationale: Grid-searched winner: SR~0.33 looks real until deflated by the honest trial count. Same file with --trials 1 PASSES — that delta is why the CLI nags when --trials is left at default.

cases.label: bad
cases.rationale: Martingale/pick-up-pennies: 85% wins PASSES sample_size. Anyone screening on win rate ships this and blows up. DSR must catch it.

cases.label: bad
cases.catches_via: deflated_sharpe warn + param_overfit_ratio warn (no single fail, worst-of still not pass)
cases.rationale: Lottery ticket: one +3000 outlier funds 59 losers. Nothing FAILS outright — the corpus asserts the engine at least refuses to PASS it.

cases.label: bad
cases.rationale: In-regime backtest (trend-month only) that dies out-of-sample. A CSV carries no held-out info, so v1 CANNOT see it — engine passes, and that FN is recorded here on purpose. Fix needs train/held-out split (cloud scope, roadmap non-goal for engine). If a future check ever catches this, update the manifest.

cases.label: good
cases.rationale: Trust anchor: 200 trades, 62% wins, SR~0.73. Must stay pass — regression tripwire against over-strict future checks.

cases.label: good
cases.rationale: Moderate real edge (60% wins, SR~0.27, 120 trades). Guards the pass-side boundary: tightening thresholds must not start flagging ordinary good backtests.

cases.label: good
cases.rationale: Smallest good case kept (100 trades, 65% wins, SR~0.48). Anything smaller belongs in warn/fail territory.
